issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a function named `_make_y_state(circ, q, p)`, but the template and solution define/implement the function as `make_y_state(circ, q, p)` (no leading underscore). This name mismatch can confuse students about which function to implement and test against.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the naming consistent. Either (A) update the problem statement to request `make_y_state(circ, q, p)` (remove the underscore), or (B) change the template and solution to provide `_make_y_state(circ, q, p)` (add the underscore). Prefer (A) to match the existing template and solution.
